description: Hosts Git repos, issues, PRs, Actions CI/CD, and project management.
auth_method: OAuth2 (OAuth Apps and GitHub Apps) and fine-grained PATs
self_serve: self-serve free - free account, generous rate limits, no approval to register OAuth App or generate PAT
api_surface: very broad REST + GraphQL; official remote MCP server hosted by GitHub (OAuth-based)
blocker: none significant; rate limits on unauthenticated/PAT use

description: Frontend cloud for deploying and hosting web apps/serverless functions.
auth_method: Bearer access tokens (personal/team) or OAuth (MCP flow)
self_serve: self-serve free - Hobby free tier, tokens generated immediately
api_surface: broad REST API (deployments, projects, domains, env vars); official Vercel MCP server (public beta, mcp.vercel.com)
blocker: none major; some team-scoped resources need paid plans

description: Static site/web app hosting and CI/CD deployment platform.
auth_method: OAuth2 (public integrations) or Personal Access Tokens
self_serve: self-serve free - free tier account generates PAT immediately
api_surface: REST API (sites, deploys, forms, functions, DNS); official Netlify MCP server (netlify/netlify-mcp)

description: CDN, DNS, security (WAF/DDoS), edge compute (Workers), storage.
auth_method: API Tokens (Bearer, scoped) or legacy Global API Key; OAuth for hosted MCP
self_serve: self-serve free - free-tier account creates scoped API tokens with no approval
api_surface: very broad REST (Workers, R2, KV, D1, DNS, Zero Trust); official suite of remote MCP servers (mcp.cloudflare.com)
blocker: none major; Zero Trust/Enterprise features paid-gated

description: Open-source Firebase alternative: Postgres DB, auth, storage, edge functions.
auth_method: Personal Access Tokens (Bearer, sbp_ prefix) or OAuth2.1 (third-party)
self_serve: self-serve free - free-tier account generates PAT immediately
api_surface: REST Management API plus per-project auto-generated REST/GraphQL (PostgREST); official remote MCP server (32 tools)

description: Native graph database (self-managed and Aura managed cloud).
auth_method: OAuth2 client-credentials (Aura API) or username/password (Bolt driver)
self_serve: self-serve trial - Aura Free tier exists but API credential creation requires billing info on file
api_surface: Aura management REST API plus Cypher via Bolt/HTTP; official Neo4j MCP server (github.com/neo4j/mcp)
blocker: Aura API credential creation gated behind billing info for Free/Professional accounts

description: Cloud data warehouse and AI/analytics platform (Cortex).
auth_method: Key-pair JWT, OAuth2, or Programmatic Access Tokens (PAT)
self_serve: paid plan required - trial account (time-limited free credits) available, no perpetual free tier
api_surface: broad REST (SQL API, Cortex REST API, object management); official Snowflake-managed MCP server (GA)
blocker: requires trial/paid account with warehouse compute costs; key-pair/JWT setup complexity

description: Fully managed cloud MongoDB database service.
auth_method: OAuth2 client-credentials (Service Accounts) or legacy Digest API Keys
self_serve: self-serve free - Atlas free tier (M0) creates API keys/service accounts with no approval
api_surface: broad Atlas Administration REST API v2 plus Data/Query APIs; official MongoDB MCP Server (local and Atlas-hosted)
blocker: none major; legacy Digest auth being phased out

description: Observability platform (metrics, logs, traces, APM, monitors).
auth_method: API key + Application key (static tokens, header-based)
self_serve: self-serve trial - free 14-day trial generates keys immediately, no perpetual free tier for most products
api_surface: broad REST (metrics, logs, monitors, dashboards, incidents); official Datadog MCP Server (GA, hosted/remote)
blocker: usable data/features shrink after trial unless paid plan active

description: Error tracking and application performance monitoring.
auth_method: Bearer auth tokens - Organization Auth Tokens or User Auth Tokens
self_serve: self-serve free - free Developer tier creates tokens with no approval
api_surface: broad REST (issues, events, projects, releases, performance); official Sentry remote MCP server (mcp.sentry.dev)
blocker: none major; free tier has volume/event caps
